narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, brisk, urgent and excited explainer narrator. Rapid, punchy delivery, gripping, no long pauses.

barry.instruct: Giddy, giggling, dreamy and far too happy, like he is a little drunk.

sofia.instruct: Commanding flight attendant, loud, sharp and urgent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the oxygen masks drop, the most dangerous thing on the plane is how good you feel.

voice.instruct: Fast, punchy, ominous opening hook, leaning in like a secret.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Barry is at thirty-five thousand feet, and he's in trouble.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Out there, the air is so thin it can't keep a brain running.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the jet pumps air in and squeezes the cabin to feel like eight thousand feet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a door seal cracks. Air screams out, the cabin fogs, and the needle climbs.

voice.instruct: Fast, sudden alarm, a disaster unfolding at speed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before it hits fifteen thousand, the ceiling pops open and the masks drop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Grandma Rose helps everyone else first. Barry pokes the flat bag and laughs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody screams. And that should scare you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, a starving brain doesn't feel fear. It feels a warm, happy buzz.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Up here, that buzz gives you a minute at most to act.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Pull the mask down, breathe, then help!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That yank fires an oxygen generator: at least twelve minutes, even with a flat bag.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pilots mask up first, then dive to ten thousand feet, where air works again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Barry stops giggling, and the whole plane wakes up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Up there, feeling great is the warning. Mask first, then help.

voice.instruct: Brisk, warm but firm closing line, landing it.
